name: The Gilded Knight

source.note: A side quest boss of our own (The Silver Hoard, docs/story/side_quests.md): the Order of the Silver Dragon's tithe-keeper, who went down to the dragon's last winter tithe the night Argynvostholt fell and never let go of it. Built up from the 2025 Monster Manual's revenant to CR 10: silver grown over his plate, two blows, a covetous glare, Regeneration that fire and radiant stop, Legendary Resistance and two Legendary Actions. Drawn with the revenant's sprite.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.summary: Regains 10 HP at the start of its turn; Fire or Radiant damage stops that for its next turn.
traits.text: The Gilded Knight regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If it took Fire or Radiant damage, this doesn't work at the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.summary: Twice a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the Gilded Knight fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, twice a day.

traits.name: The Tithe-Keeper
traits.summary: Four hundred years on the dragon's last tithe have grown the silver over him. He can't let go of it.
traits.text: The Order's tithe-keeper went down to the dragon's last winter tithe the night the house fell, and shut the door. The coins have grown over his armour like frost over a window. He can't let go of them, and he knows it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Gilded Knight makes two Silvered Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Silvered Longsword
actions.summary: An Order blade gone heavy with silver; a cold that goes into the bone.
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Covetous Glare
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: one creature within 30 ft; DC 16 Wis save or Paralyzed for a minute (saving at the end of its turns).
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the Gilded Knight can see within 30 feet. Failure: the target has the Paralyzed condition for 1 minute, held by the look of a man watching a thief. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

options.name: Guard the Hoard
options.summary: Moves up to half his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

summary: The Order's tithe-keeper, four hundred years on the dragon's last winter tithe in the undercroft of Argynvostholt. Silver has grown over his plate like frost on a window. He swore it would reach the valley, and he can't let go of it.
